Questions

Good To Know

Do you come to me?

Yes. Mobile Detail Bros is fully mobile — we detail your vehicle at your home or workplace. You pick the day and time that works for you.

How do I book?

Use the booking builder on this page. Pick your ride, your detail, a day and a time, then tap the button — it opens a text with everything filled in. Just press send. Your booking is confirmed when Peter replies and approves it.

How long does a detail take?

Hand Car Wash takes about 1 hour. Platinum Detail takes 3-4 hours. Diamond Detail takes 4-6 hours.

What is Permanent Tire Coating?

It lasts the life of the tire, is dry to the touch, and does not sling onto your paint like regular tire dressing. One application — $200.

What does headlight restoration fix?

Cloudy, yellowed headlights are polished back to clear and sealed for protection. Standard restoration is $45; Level II is $145.
